meta.name: nano-banana-2
meta.description: Generate images with Google Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2) via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, multi-image input (up to 14 images), Google Search grounding. Triggers: nano banana 2, nanobanana 2, gemini 3.1 flash image, gemini 3 1 flash image preview, google image generation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成并编辑图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过命令行快速生成或编辑图像
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images from text or images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or edit images via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过命令行调用 Google Gemini 3.1 Flash 模型来生成或编辑图片。支持文字生图、多图输入（最多 14 张）、图片编辑、自定义比例和分辨率，还能结合 Google 搜索获取实时信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“nano banana 2”、“gemini 3.1 flash image”等关键词，或要求生成/编辑图片时触发。

say.text: 用 Gemini 3.1 Flash 生成一张太空中的香蕉，照片级真实。
say.note: Claude 会调用命令生成图片。

say.text: 把这张风景图加上彩虹，用 Gemini 3.1 Flash 编辑。
say.note: 需要提供图片链接，Claude 会执行编辑。

say.text: 生成 4 张 16:9 的咖啡店极简 logo，4K 分辨率。
say.note: Claude 会设置参数生成多张图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the command line to call Google Gemini 3.1 Flash model to generate or edit images. Supports text-to-image, multi-image input (up to 14 images), image editing, custom aspect ratio and resolution, and can optionally use Google Search for real-time grounding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "nano banana 2", "gemini 3.1 flash image", or ask to generate/edit images.

say_en.text: Generate a photorealistic banana in space using Gemini 3.1 Flash.
say_en.note: Claude will run the command to generate the image.

say_en.text: Edit this landscape image by adding a rainbow using Gemini 3.1 Flash.
say_en.note: Provide an image URL; Claude will perform the edit.

say_en.text: Generate 4 coffee shop minimalist logos at 16:9, 4K resolution.
say_en.note: Claude will set parameters to generate multiple images.
